title: The dynamics in health-related quality of life of patients with stable coronary artery disease were revealed: a network analysis
limitations:
- Networks are exploratory, not confirmatory; edges cannot be interpreted as true causal relationships.
- Centrality measures of temporal networks should be interpreted with caution.
- A subset of eight items was selected, which may lead to less informative network structures and inflated centrality measures.
- Patient-level networks are not generalizable to other persons.
- Time lags between beeps varied, which may affect the network structure.
- Multilevel VAR model assumes all individuals’ parameters originate from the same distribution, which may not always be realistic.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated in the paper, but supplementary materials are referenced. The supplementary materials link may need to be checked for availability.
